note: Skill bodies live in plugin/skills/<name>/SKILL.md and ship in the plugin tarball as dist/skills/. This index is the agent-agnostic discovery map; mcp_tools are the real tool names exposed by supabase/functions/mcp-server.

skills.title: Set up a WZRD Studio project
skills.description: Draft a project's storyline, scenes and shots after quoting and confirming the cost (3 credits plus 1 per shot), then hand the user the timeline deep link.

skills.title: Storyboard a project for free (propose / diff / commit)
skills.description: Stage scene and shot deltas, review the diff and continuity warnings, then commit at the revision you diffed against. Free.

skills.title: Generate one shot image (spends credits)
skills.description: dryRun cost preview, explicit confirmation of the exact credit number, then one idempotent spend.

skills.title: Compile and review the Seedance reference packet
skills.description: Review mode is free and stops before submitting; auto mode is refused while Seedance 2.5 pricing is unverified.

skills.title: Execute a Studio compute graph (spends credits)
skills.description: Run a saved node graph after explicit confirmation of a quote that is a floor, not an exact total.

skills.title: Edit a timeline for free
skills.description: Rewrite prompts, fix continuity edges, restructure scenes and shots; clip-level editing stays in the web editor.

skills.title: Render every pending shot, scene by scene (spends credits)
skills.description: Quote each scene with dryRun, sum the total, confirm it, then run one idempotent job per scene.

skills.title: Export the final cut
skills.description: Assemble the Director's Cut from media that already exists; assembly is free, the shot media it needs is not.

skills.title: Credits, catalog prices, caps, and top-ups
skills.description: Explain balances, per-token daily caps, scope errors, and create a Stripe checkout URL. Free.
